citation: OpenStreetMap contributors (2026). Pakistan extract [Data file]. Geofabrik GmbH. Retrieved 2026-04-29 from https://download.geofabrik.de/asia/pakistan.html

Used for exposure analysis; KKH and tributary bridges identified manually. Acknowledged as limitation in Methods and Discussion.
